name: olivertwins-RE
install:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -f pds6502.py ]; then
  asm=.
elif [ -f pds6502/pds6502.py ]; then
  asm=pds6502
elif [ -f repos/pds6502/pds6502.py ]; then
  asm=repos/pds6502
elif [ -f ../pds6502/pds6502.py ]; then
  asm=../pds6502
elif [ -f /agent/repos/pds6502/pds6502.py ]; then
  asm=/agent/repos/pds6502
else
  echo "pds6502.py not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
python3 -m py_compile "$asm/pds6502.py" "$asm/pds_extract.py" "$asm/tests/smoke_test.py"
python3 "$asm/tests/smoke_test.py"
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  root=.
elif [ -f magicianedit/package-lock.json ]; then
  root=magicianedit
elif [ -f repos/magicianedit/package-lock.json ]; then
  root=repos/magicianedit
else
  echo "package-lock.json not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cd "$root"
npm ci
start:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  root=.
elif [ -f magicianedit/package.json ]; then
  root=magicianedit
elif [ -f repos/magicianedit/package.json ]; then
  root=repos/magicianedit
else
  echo "package.json not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cd "$root"
exec npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
